reviewBoundaries: The four new implementations are finite typed source lowerings with exact package/profile guards.
Seven existing-profile extensions require actual constructor/lifecycle execution; profile-guard acceptance alone is insufficient.
Six legacy controls retain their separate accepted source/type-closure proofs and are not claimed as selected73 lifecycle fixtures.
Host adapters do not establish GPU rendering, native audio playback, full route completion or on-device save authority. Those remain mandatory physical observations.
